note: Synthetic data. One fixed wording per question; use it identically in training, evaluation and inference.

main_question.label: is_fraud
main_question.instructions: Does this SIM replacement request look like a SIM-swap fraud attempt?

IMEI_CHANGE.instructions: Was the device IMEI changed during this SIM replacement request?

UNUSUAL_HOUR.instructions: Was this SIM replacement request made between 00:00 and 05:59?

LOCATION_GAP.instructions: Is the distance between the previous and current locations more than 300 km?

FAILED_AUTHENTICATIONS.instructions: Were there 3 or more failed authentication attempts?

SUPPORT_CALLS.instructions: Were there 2 or more support calls within the last 24 hours?

RECENT_SIM_SWAP.instructions: Did a previous SIM swap occur less than 30 days ago?

OTP_BURST.instructions: Is the OTP request count 4 or more?
